    • turnBottomDetailsNotVisible

      public void turnBottomDetailsNotVisible()

    • showRouteDetails

      public void showRouteDetails(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop> routeEdge)
      Displays the details of the selected route edge in the bottom details' pane. This includes making the pane visible, dynamically populating the route details table, and showing the incident stop details.
      Parameters:
      routeEdge - the edge representing the route whose details are to be displayed.

    • updateRouteIncidentStops

      public void updateRouteIncidentStops(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop> routeEdge)
      Displays details of the incident stops of the selected route in the bottom details' pane. This includes showing the name, number of connections, latitude, and longitude for both the first and second stops of the route.
      Parameters:
      routeEdge - the edge representing the route whose incident stop details are to be displayed.
